name: Anonymous Whistleblower Channel
trigger: Any Brick Dynamics employee identifies a potential issue they want to report anonymously.
purpose: A company-wide channel that lets anyone at Brick Dynamics report a concern anonymously, with confidential handling. The source page is a reference link, not a step-by-step process; the receiving side is not documented.
doneWhen: The concern has been submitted through the form and received for confidential handling.

steps.title: Submit the concern through the anonymous form
steps.trigger: You have identified a concern to report.
steps.work: Open the Whistleblower form (Google Form linked from the Automation Hub page) and submit the concern. The form does not collect your identity.

steps.title: Confidential handling of the report
steps.work: The report is handled confidentially. Who receives it and what happens next is not documented on the source page; the owner should fill this in.
